title: 第20章 应战第21章 大棒糖果
content_zh:
“明白！”
福伯如痴如醉的点着头，小小一个殿堂级的要领，直接将他的炼药技术提升到了一个新的境界。
“咕咚！”
当肖恩开始炼化雷云豹魔核时，饶是以福伯的沉稳，也不由得微现紧张之色，尤其是一旁的乔泰，更是心颤的咽了一口唾沫。
在他看来，就算是没有雷云豹魔核，以肖恩炼制的活脉药液，也足以解除福伯身上的顽疾。
众所周知，魔核乃炼制丹药的主要材料，同时，也是魔兽毕生精华所在，同样的带有魔兽的狂暴特性。
可以说，哪怕是最高级的极品药液，也承受不起魔核的狂暴。
两者之间，就像硝酸和甘油一样，根本就无法融合，一旦接触，便会产生难以控制的……
爆炸！
况且，三级雷属性的兽核，哪怕就是三品炼药师都未必能够炼化。
而只有能够炼制丹药的，才能够称之为真正的炼药师，就连福伯，也未曾达到。
福伯却是摆了摆手，在肖恩身上，他看到的是沉稳，而不是不可能。
肖恩微微一笑，手掌一招，灵魂感知力将控制火焰合适的温度，再度将雷云豹魔核包裹。
啪啪啪！
火焰中，雷光闪烁，几乎弥漫了整朵火焰，尤其是一旁的乔雅和乔横二人，仿佛是看到一头弱化版的雷云豹在火焰中咆哮。
喉咙咕咚之声，络绎不绝！
“封！”
肖恩一声低喝，整朵火焰开始缓缓的旋转，最后犹如一个密封的火球悬浮在半空中。
火球之内，雷光闪烁，却无法穿透火焰，甚为绚丽和奇异。
雷系魔核最珍贵的便是雷霆能量，肖恩怎么可能会让这雷光窜出火焰。

隆隆！
低沉雷鸣声传出，一道道闪电陆续出现，却是随着火焰的腾烧越来越稀疏，福伯看到这奇异的场景有些兴奋，也有些紧张。
不过，他同样已经看到了雷云豹魔核难逃被炼化的厄运。
笑话，区区三级雷云豹魔核，怎么可能经得起天地玄火的煅烧，如果不是为了达到让魔核能量与药液契合，肖恩根本就不需要花这么多心机。
嗤！
在缓慢的煅烧中，那雷云豹魔核最后的一丝狂暴被剔除，已经完全看不到雷光闪烁。
咔嚓！
半晌之后，随着一声清脆的声响，魔核表面竟然从中间裂开，并被肖恩驱逐出火焰之外，最后一小团透明糊状能量静静的悬殊在火焰当中。
“呼！”
望着这团从狂暴中变得温和的能量团，乔泰擦了擦额头上的汗水，轻轻的吐了一口气。
就算是以他那滥竽充数的炼药术，都有五成把握能够将药液融合，更别说是肖恩了。
content_en:
"Understood!"
Uncle Fu nodded his head in ecstasy. A small palace-level key directly raised his medicine refining skills to a new level.
"Gudong!"
When Sean began to refine the Thunder Cloud Leopard Demonic Core, even with Fu Bo's calmness, he couldn't help but become slightly nervous, especially Qiao Tai beside him, who swallowed with trembling heart.
In his opinion, even without the Thunder Cloud Leopard Demonic Core, the pulse-vitalizing liquid refined by Sean was enough to relieve Fu Bo's stubborn illness.
As we all know, magic core is the main material for refining elixirs. At the same time, it is also the essence of Warcraft's life. It also has the violent characteristics of Warcraft.
It can be said that even the most advanced medicinal liquid cannot withstand the violence of the magic core.
The two, just like nitric acid and glycerin, cannot be fused at all. Once they come into contact, uncontrollable...
Explosion!
Moreover, even a third-level alchemist may not be able to refine the beast core with the third-level thunder attribute.
Only those who can refine elixirs can be called true alchemists, and even Uncle Fu has never reached this level.
Fu Bo waved his hand. In Sean, he saw calmness, not impossibility.
Sean smiled slightly, and with a move of his palm, his soul perception would control the appropriate temperature of the flame, and once again wrap the Thunder Cloud Leopard's magic core.
Bang bang bang!
In the flames, thunder light flickered, almost filling the entire flame. Especially Qiao Ya and Qiao Heng, who were standing beside them, seemed to see a weakened version of the Thunder Cloud Leopard roaring in the flames.
There is an endless stream of gurgling sounds in the throat!
"Seal!"
Sean shouted, and the whole flame began to rotate slowly, and finally it was like a sealed fireball suspended in the air.
Within the fireball, the lightning flashed, but could not penetrate the flames. It was very gorgeous and strange.
The most precious thing about the thunder magic core is the thunder energy. How could Sean make this thunder burst into flames?
rumble!
There was a low thunder, and lightning appeared one after another, but as the flames burned, it became more and more sparse. Fu Bo was a little excited and a little nervous when he saw this strange scene.
However, he has also seen that the Thunder Cloud Leopard Demonic Core cannot escape the fate of being refined.
It’s a joke. How could a mere third-level Thundercloud Leopard Demonic Core withstand the burning of the mysterious fire of heaven and earth? If it weren’t for the purpose of matching the energy of the Demonic Core with the medicinal liquid, Sean wouldn’t have had to spend so much effort.
laugh!
During the slow calcination, the last trace of violence in the Thunder Cloud Leopard Demonic Core was eliminated, and the flash of lightning could no longer be seen at all.
Click!
After a while, with a crisp sound, the surface of the magic core actually split from the middle, and was driven out of the flames by Sean. The last small group of transparent mushy energy was quietly disparate in the flames.
"Phew!"
Looking at this ball of energy that had turned from violent to gentle, Qiao Tai wiped the sweat from his forehead and let out a gentle breath.
Even with his shoddy medicine refining skills, he was 50% sure that he could fuse the medicine, let alone Sean.
